summary: Each engine row gets a run-to-run variation field next to its class's q (D20).
note: Landed in #636 on 2026-11-04, which integrated #612's Lean stack after #612 closed unmerged (commit bd8b364c2, "Run-to-run variation per engine row"). The checker reports each choices row's variation as `rerun_observation`, and `docs/core-semantics.md` states it beside the class. No later ruling supersedes it: F42 (D48) amends D20 on the class level `Report.deterministic` reports, and leaves the per-row variation in place.
